notes.title: 🍓 ANNOUNCING THE STRAWBERRY REVOLUTION 🍓
notes.content:
🧩 SLEEK. SMOOTH. SATISFYING.
Discover the new feel of clicking.

We’ve supercharged the visual feedback and streamlined navigation to make every click feel magical. It’s not just a game—it’s a sensory delight.


🌱 60% LIGHTER. 100% GREENER 
Strawberry’s never tasted this clean.

We’ve slashed resource usage by 60%—less RAM, more room for strawberries (and your other apps). Play longer, smoother, and guilt-free, knowing you’re part of a greener, cleaner future. 🌍


💾 YOUR SAVE. YOUR JOURNEY (NO COMPROMISES)
This is YOUR world. We’re just living in it.  

Introducing dedicated Steam Cloud saves. Your progress? Now untouchable. Your choices? Forever yours. Switch devices, take breaks, or start fresh—your journey is yours alone. And yes, your strawberries are safe.


⚖️ EQUAL GROUND. EQUAL STRAWBERRIES
No internet? Old laptop? We’ve got you.

We heard you. We saw you. And we acted. Introducing a 3-minute grace period for every players—because fairness isn’t a luxury. Plus, our offline mode is now turbo-optimized for slower setups. Whether you’re on a spaceship or a potato PC, your strawberries matter. 🌟  


🎯 FOR THE COMMUNITY 

This update isn’t just about what’s new—it’s about who we’re building for. You. The clickers, the strategists, the midnight strawberry hoarders. Together, we’re crafting a world where every click counts and every player thrives.  


🔥 READY TO DIVE IN? 
Update now. Trade smarter. Click louder.  

**P.S.** Tag your fellow farmers in the comments, let's build history together. 🍓✨

#StrawberryRevolution #ClickDifferent #Clicker

notes.title: 🍓Strawberry Launch Event🍓
notes.content:
Welcome to Strawberry - Launch Event! 

We're excited to announce the launch of Strawberry! To celebrate this special occasion, we've prepared some sweet rewards for our players.

    Steam Item Rewards    

Every 3 hours of gameplay, you'll receive a delicious strawberry to add to your collection!

    Special Launch Day Bonus    

First 24 Hours Only!
    
Don't miss out on the chance to obtain the exclusive Day1Strawberry! This special collectible will only be available during the first 24 hours after launch.
    
Join us now and start your strawberry collecting adventure!
    
Happy collecting! 🍓
